_description: Essential File, Edit and basic navigation only. No chord commands. Best for new users or low-distraction setups.
_comment: The only subtractive profile: everything starts unbound and 'keep' names what survives, each at its current default chord. As an overlay it removed nothing -- all 415 default bindings stayed, so 'Minimal' was minimal in name only (bad.md P2.6). app.exit is kept deliberately: quitting used to survive by accident. edit.replace_all is moved rather than kept because its default is now a QUILL Key chord, and this profile promises none.
